name: Valenza
summary: Valenza presents a compelling balance of contrast and harmony. A refined ceramic top rests above a body wrapped in dark grey elm veneer, exuding subtle texture. Warm metallic legs in a brass finish anchor the silhouette, while soft grey inner panels lend a discreet layer of refinement. 220x42x50
